fixed_findings: Intermediate 九 lines now have yang polarity and are checked against canonical bits.
用九 and 用六 are returned and included in interpretation focus for all-moving Qian and Kun casts.
Caller-provided empty or malformed datasets are no longer replaced by disk data.
Tuan and Xiang are available through the same wing query boundary as the seven local wing files.
Xiang access now exposes 64 大象 records and 384 小象 records.
A ten-component Wing catalog now distinguishes Tuan/Xiang, Wenyan, Xici, Shuogua, Xugua, and Zagua.
English Legge data now has structured judgment and six-line fields for all 64 hexagrams.
Float and boolean cast values are rejected.
CLI validation errors are concise argparse errors without tracebacks.
limitations: The structured English dataset is imported from an external public-domain Legge implementation and should still be spot-checked against the original Sacred Texts HTML/1882 edition before publication.
The moving-line interpretation policy is explicit and fixed as explicit_moving_line_policy_v1; it is not a claim of one universal historical school.
CLI currently exposes casting, not a separate wing or translation query command.
